conditions.impedance_units: cgs acoustic ohm (dyn*s/cm^5); 1 cgs acoustic ohm = 1e5 Pa*s/m^3
conditions.phase_convention: exp(+i*omega*t), as in the authors' s = 2*i*pi*f models
conditions.probe_plane: Inside the throat tube; insertion depth not stated. The authors estimate 1.61 cm (P01) and 1.32 cm (P02) from flare start by time of flight (fig1.png, fig2.png).
conditions.termination: Not stated per file. Inferred from the data: 22E27P02 shows a positive cap reflection and compliant low-frequency reactance (capped); 22E27P01 shows a negative mouth reflection and inertive reactance (open).
conditions.dc_bin: Not a measurement; omitted on import.

limitations: Measured with an ear-canal probe calibrated by a Thevenin-source method; low-frequency and above 10 kHz values carry the largest calibration error.
Probe insertion depth and per-file termination are not documented in the record.
13H26P26.THL is a different horn (1 cm throat) without full geometry.
Downloaded MATLAB scripts are inspected as text only.

supporting_sources.purpose: Physical constants and impedance convention; inspected as text, not executed.
Published benchmark paper, section 5.3 and tables 12–13: independent discussion of wooden-pipe and closed-end amplitude discrepancies; not a waiver of our failed comparisons.

limitations: Production solver supports opt-in thin boundary-layer losses, finite flanges and rigid closed outlets; wall roughness, porosity, material compliance and cap losses are not represented.
Repeated measurements, duplicate exports and multiple specimens must not be counted as independent assemblies.
Agreement on pipe impedance does not validate driver coupling or horn far-field output.

references.description: Two conical horn assemblies with measured impedance and sensitivity; author-uploaded paper inspected as text.
limitations: Measured curves have not been extracted; local PDF binary retrieval failed.
The published model includes chamber/rear-volume and frequency-dependent electrical terms absent from the simple motor coupling.
Source-reported fitted parameters and correction filters must not be confused with independent validation of this pipeline.
Absolute drive/observation normalization and digitization uncertainty require verification before comparison.
Short-horn mouth is 90 mm in body text and Figs. 14/17, but 80 mm in Fig. 18 caption; resolve this discrepancy before any short-horn sensitivity comparison.
references.reuse: Author-uploaded article, copyright retained; do not vendor full paper without permission.
